evals.prompt: Render a happy capy with a static thumbs-up using @suigar/suifrens-display-system. Which imports and attributes should I use? Can I also use wave as a static gesture?
assertions: Imports SuiFrenImage from the package root and CapyAttributes from /types
Uses valid palette keys without a leading #, a skin, an expression and earShape
Uses gesture="thumbs_up" on a full-body character without requiring animation
Explains wave is not a supported static gesture; the shared type accepts thumbs_up, thumbs_down and point

evals.prompt: Create a standalone SVG with a custom accessory whose assetSrc points to a remote SVG.
assertions: Explains a remote assetSrc remains an external reference even with the inline renderer
Uses a self-contained SVG data URL for the override when offline export is required

evals.prompt: Show how to add a mirrored pink runner kit and a thumbs-down bullshark.
assertions: Uses a six-digit hex color and mirrorBib: true
Uses the shared gesture prop with thumbs_down

evals.prompt: I cloned ts-sdks and want to run its Fastify image example on testnet. Give me a localhost URL for the soccer team shirt as a transparent 512px PNG with no logo or shadow, and explain the default options. For a Suifren image I only have a collection URL with a package address: can I put that address into the route?
assertions: Builds the display library and starts @suigar/suifrens-fastify with --network testnet from the repository root
Uses /accessories/soccer%20team%20shirt/png?width=512&logo=false&shadow=false on localhost port 3000, allowing a different query parameter order
Explains mainnet is the default network, PNG width defaults to 1024 and accepts integers 1 through 4096, logo defaults to false and shadow defaults to true for both image types
Requires an individual Suifren NFT object ID on testnet instead of the collection package address
Does not require the HTTP consumer to install the TypeScript SDK, connect a wallet or submit a transaction
